questions.prompt: How are you feeling about your workload and pace this week?
How has your energy been lately — are you able to properly recharge outside of work?
How connected do you feel to your team right now, and do you feel supported when things get tough?
How confident are you feeling about what's ahead — are you getting what you need to grow and do your best work?
Stepping back, how ready and prepared do you feel for what's coming up?

interpretation.low: Strong overall readiness — your reflections point to solid workload balance, energy, support, and confidence. Keep up the great momentum!
interpretation.moderate: Moderate readiness — some areas sound steady while others may benefit from a bit more support or attention.
interpretation.high: Lower readiness right now — several areas suggest extra support could help. Consider checking in with your manager or a wellbeing resource.
